items.content: Fullstack Engineering. I work with React, Next.js, Node.js, and FastAPI. I build complete products, covering everything from the database schema to frontend deployment.
AI Integration. I write APIs that connect LLMs to structured data, using prompt engineering, serverless backends, and agentic workflows to solve concrete problems.
Linux & Tooling. I develop on Fedora Linux. Clean git history, automated tests, and terminal-centric workflows are part of how I work.

content.title: About
content.subtitle: Building software that works, on the tools I trust.
content.bio: Fullstack Developer and UTN student based in Argentina. I build products end-to-end, from the database schema to the frontend deployment. I connect React frontends with FastAPI backends and integrate LLMs as structured tools instead of simple wrappers.
content.details: I value clean git history, automated tests, and local environments tuned for fast feedback. If you need someone to bridge frontend, backend, and AI, let's talk.
